purpose: Teach: クイーン/神戸大学/日本テレビ/ヤマハ/セルビア/養老/慶應義塾/中国共産党

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、クイーンのボヘミアン・ラプソディ歌ってたな
lines.en: Riku, I caught you singing Queen's Bohemian Rhapsody the other day.
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the opening. Casual, knowing tone — she's caught him at something. Slight smirk in the delivery, not unkind. Quick pace, like she's enjoying his discomfort.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、神戸大学志望だったな、桜
lines.en: So you're applying to Kobe University, huh Sakura?
lines.style: Turning her observation back on her. Light, even tone — match her energy but with a hint of counter-offense. Relaxed delivery, like he's been waiting for his chance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、日本テレビの番組観てたな
lines.en: Riku, I know you were watching that Nippon TV show.
lines.style: Same teasing rhythm as before. She's building a case. Bright, almost sing-song quality to the accusation. Leaning into the game of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヤマハの音楽教室通ってたな、桜
lines.en: You took piano lessons at Yamaha, didn't you Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her pace now. Slight warmth underneath — he knows these things about her. Delivered with quiet confidence, like each fact is another piece he's been collecting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でセルビア習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study Serbia in your world history class?
lines.style: Slight breathlessness on the opening — she's building her list faster. Playful intensity rising. Quick, staccato rhythm. Testing whether he'll fold first.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で養老温泉行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your family went to Yoro Hot Springs, didn't they Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter now, more pointed. Not aggressive — intimate, even. He's showing her how much he's been paying attention. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、慶應義塾大学志望だな
lines.en: Riku, you're applying to Keio University, aren't you?
lines.style: Slight triumph in her tone. She's landed something bigger. Quick attack on the opening, then settling into certainty. A smile audible at the edge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で中国共産党の歴史習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied the history of the Communist Party in your social studies class too, didn't you Sakura?
lines.style: Slower, deliberate delivery on this one. He's saving the best for last. Each clause lands with weight. Warm underneath — not accusatory, almost intimate. Slight pause before her name.
